obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.obtainedFrom: Louisiana State Police (Right to Review) or the parish sheriff
obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.description: Obtain Louisiana criminal background check dated within the past sixty days. Louisiana State Police recommends a fingerprint-based Right to Review, because the motion must match the state rap sheet on arrest and booking date, original arrest charge, arrest number and counts. Order it so it is still inside its sixty-day life on the day the motion is filed; the Article 989 form marks it required on its face.

obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.obtainedFrom: Clerk of court for the parish
obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.description: Obtain Bill of information or indictment for each charge. Ask the clerk of court in the parish of arrest or conviction for a copy of the bill of information or indictment for each charge on the arrest.

obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.obtainedFrom: Clerk of court for the parish
obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.description: Obtain Minute entry showing the final disposition. Ask the clerk of court for the minute entry that shows how each charge was finally disposed of.
Check your answer to "How did the case against you end?" against Minute entry showing the final disposition, and correct the packet if they disagree.

obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.obtainedFrom: The district attorney's office for the parish
obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.description: Obtain Returned Article 988 Motion for Fee Exemption, completed and signed by the district attorney. The packet gives you the Article 988 form with your own fields filled in. Take or send it to the district attorney's office BEFORE the motion is filed. The district attorney or a designee completes the certification boxes and signs, and returns it within fifteen days. Append it to the motion at filing only if you are found eligible. Filing without it means paying the fee, and Article 983 makes the fee non-refundable even if the motion is denied.

obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.obtainedFrom: The district attorney's office for the parish
obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.description: Obtain District attorney certification letter for the underlying entitlement. Whichever certification the underlying Article 976, 977 or 978 basis requires. The packet's cover request names the exact certification for the basis selected.

obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.obtainedFrom: The district attorney, the Louisiana Bureau of Criminal Identification and Information and the arresting law-enforcement agency
obtainOrConfirmBeforeFiling.description: Obtain Affidavit of No Opposition from each named agency. The agencies' own instrument on the Article 990 form. LegalEase cannot prepare, complete or sign it.

Race and gender — Article 989 Motion, Part I Defendant Information.
The participant's signature and the date of signing — Article 989 Motion, unrepresented-mover signature block on the final page.
Every certification box and the district attorney's signature on the Article 988 Motion for Fee Exemption — Article 988 Motion for Fee Exemption, the certification section and signature block.
The whole of the Article 990 Affidavit of Response — Not printed in the participant packet; described in the filing instructions only.
The clerk's service of the motion and of the order and judgment — Not printed in the participant packet; described in the filing instructions only.

The redaction paragraph of the Article 992 Order, including the identification of each record location and the information to be redacted — Article 992 Order of Expungement — the Article 985 redaction paragraph.
The mover signs the Article 989 Motion in the block headed 'If not represented by counsel'. LegalEase leaves the signature and date blank.
Article 983(A) caps the total cost at five hundred fifty dollars, collected by the clerk at filing and non-refundable even if the motion is denied.
Article 983(F) through the Article 988 Motion for Fee Exemption where the underlying basis meets its grounds.
